sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 2 OF 2000
SUPREME COURT
JUDGES (LEAVE, PENSION AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2000
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 2
OF 2000
An Order further
to amend the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1997
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th December, 2000]
F. No. 2(2)/2000-Pub., date
6-12-2000.---The following Order made by the President is hereby published
for general information:--
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1997
(P.O. No. 2 of 1997)), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
Now, therefore, in exercise o the
powers con err by the Fifth Schedule to the Constitution of Islamic Republic of
Pakistan, the President is pleased to take the following Order-
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Order may be called the Supreme Court Judges
(Leave, Pension and Privileges (Amendment) Order, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of paragraph
16-A, P.O. No.2 of 1997.---In the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and
Privileges) Order, 1997 (P.O. No.2 of 1997), in paragraph 16A for sub-paragraph
(1) the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(1) Where a retired Judge in receipt of pension is
appointed to, or is holding, a post in connection with the affairs of the
Federation or a Province or a body owned or controlled by the Federal
Government or a Provincial Government, he shall be entitled to receive full
pension in addition to pay, allowances and privileges of the post on which he
is re employed in accordance with the rules applicable on re-employment to
retired civil servants."
